summary: Public Storage filed a Form 8-K reporting Items 5.07 (Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders) and 8.01 (Other Events). The event date is May 6, 2026. This is a routine current report disclosing shareholder voting results and other unspecified events. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is indicated. The filing is a standard periodic disclosure with no special-situation triggers.
